headline: Enhance CodeClip with AI-Powered Features
summary: Integrate AI-driven code analysis and categorization to improve user experience, and add a snippet suggestion feature based on recent trends in the tech community.
actions: Implement an AI-powered code analysis tool that can automatically categorize snippets by functionality, programming language, and complexity level.
Add a real-time snippet suggestion feature using natural language processing (NLP) to recommend relevant code snippets based on user queries and search history.
